critical_code_review_comments: MINOR: workspace_routes.list_signatures returns records with `{'_id': 0}` projection but does NOT explicitly exclude 'token'. That is intentional so hosted links work, but signed 'document_snapshot' can be a very large string and is returned for every signature request in the response — consider projecting a lean subset (request_id, token, agreement_type, agreement_title, status, board_member_name, board_member_email, application_id, created_at, updated_at) to keep the /signatures response payload small.

MINOR: refinement_routes.material_pdf pulls org_name from opportunities.find_one WITHOUT filtering by status — a member with multiple opportunities gets an arbitrary one. Preferable: filter by user_id and take the most recent by updated_at, or fall back to recruitment_profiles.data.organization_name.

MINOR: material_pdf title parameter defaults to material['title']. Some seeded/older materials in Mongo may not have a top-level 'title' (older schema — title lives inside versions[].structured.title). Consider `material.get('title') or GENERATION_TYPES.get(material['type'], {}).get('title', 'Document')` to avoid KeyError on legacy rows.

MINOR: public_opportunity_routes.SignPayload has no MIME allow-list for signature_image beyond 'data:image' prefix — an attacker could POST 'data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg onload=...>' up to 300000 bytes. Consider restricting to data:image/png or data:image/jpeg base64 payloads only.

MINOR: OnboardingSession model accepts any string for 'timezone' and 'format' — no server-side validation that timezone is in the ET/CT/MT/PT/AT/HT/Other set or format in Virtual/In Person/Hybrid. UI enforces this today but a direct API caller could store 'timezone': '<script>'. Consider a Literal[...] enum.
MINOR: review_routes.shared_resource does not add HTTP cache headers or ETag; hosted branded documents will re-hit Mongo on every load. Low priority for MVP volumes.
